<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 360" font-family="'Courier New',monospace">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="ll-vig" cx="50%" cy="46%" r="74%">
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#000000" stop-opacity="0.9"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="ll-gold" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffe9a8"/>
      <stop offset="46%" stop-color="#f0b429"/>
      <stop offset="54%" stop-color="#a8730c"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#f5cf6b"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="ll-spot" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffd977" stop-opacity="0.30"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffd977" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="ll-plinth" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#241a10"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#6b5230"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#241a10"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <pattern id="ll-scan" width="4" height="4" patternUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
      <rect x="0" y="0" width="4" height="2" fill="#000000" opacity="0.22"/>
    </pattern>
    <style>
      .ll-flick{animation:llfl 4.1s steps(1,end) infinite}
      @keyframes llfl{0%,91%{opacity:1}93%{opacity:.82}95%{opacity:1}97%{opacity:.93}100%{opacity:1}}
      .ll-bulb{animation:llb 1.2s steps(1,end) infinite}
      @keyframes llb{0%,49%{fill:#ffdf8a}50%,100%{fill:#5c4413}}
      .ll-turn{animation:llt 9s linear infinite;transform-origin:320px 258px}
      @keyframes llt{0%{transform:scaleX(1)}25%{transform:scaleX(.12)}50%{transform:scaleX(-1)}75%{transform:scaleX(-.12)}100%{transform:scaleX(1)}}
      .ll-ttl{fill:url(#ll-gold);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:11px}
      .ll-sub{fill:#b89a5e;letter-spacing:3.5px}
      .ll-tag{fill:#8a7442;letter-spacing:2px}
      .ll-cur{fill:#ffdf8a;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:1px}
    </style>
  </defs>

  <!-- studio black, warmed by the only lamp anybody could find -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="640" height="360" fill="#0a0705"/>
  <path d="M262 0 L378 0 L470 300 L170 300 Z" fill="url(#ll-spot)"/>

  <g class="ll-flick">
    <!-- chase bulbs, top and bottom, running opposite ways -->
    <g>
      <circle class="ll-bulb" cx="40"  cy="22" r="3.5" style="animation-delay:0s"/>
      <circle class="ll-bulb" cx="90"  cy="22" r="3.5" style="animation-delay:.15s"/>
      <circle class="ll-bulb" cx="140" cy="22" r="3.5" style="animation-delay:.3s"/>
      <circle class="ll-bulb" cx="190" cy="22" r="3.5" style="animation-delay:.45s"/>
      <circle class="ll-bulb" cx="240" cy="22" r="3.5" style="animation-delay:.6s"/>
      <circle class="ll-bulb" cx="290" cy="22" r="3.5" style="animation-delay:.75s"/>
      <circle class="ll-bulb" cx="350" cy="22" r="3.5" style="animation-delay:.9s"/>
      <circle class="ll-bulb" cx="400" cy="22" r="3.5" style="animation-delay:1.05s"/>
      <circle class="ll-bulb" cx="450" cy="22" r="3.5" style="animation-delay:0s"/>
      <circle class="ll-bulb" cx="550" cy="22" r="3.5" style="animation-delay:.3s"/>
      <circle class="ll-bulb" cx="600" cy="22" r="3.5" style="animation-delay:.45s"/>
    </g>
    <!-- 500 is dead. It has been dead a while. -->
    <circle cx="500" cy="22" r="3.5" fill="#2a2115"/>

    <!-- the title -->
    <text class="ll-ttl" x="320" y="124" font-size="40" text-anchor="middle">THE LAST LOT</text>
    <line x1="128" y1="142" x2="512" y2="142" stroke="#8a6a1e" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text class="ll-sub" x="320" y="166" font-size="12" text-anchor="middle">EVERYTHING MUST GO.  IT DID.</text>

    <!-- the plinth, and the lot turning on it under the good lights -->
    <g class="ll-turn">
      <ellipse cx="320" cy="236" rx="46" ry="30" fill="#1b140c" stroke="#c79a3c" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <path d="M292 236 L348 236 M320 214 L320 258" stroke="#6d5525" stroke-width="1"/>
    </g>
    <ellipse cx="320" cy="262" rx="66" ry="11" fill="#000000" opacity="0.75"/>
    <rect x="272" y="262" width="96" height="20" fill="url(#ll-plinth)"/>
    <ellipse cx="320" cy="262" rx="48" ry="8" fill="#7d6035"/>
    <rect x="258" y="282" width="124" height="7" fill="#3a2c19"/>

    <!-- lot tag, left -->
    <g>
      <rect x="44" y="228" width="126" height="52" fill="#120d08" stroke="#6d5525" stroke-width="1"/>
      <text class="ll-tag" x="56" y="250" font-size="11">LOT 41</text>
      <text class="ll-tag" x="56" y="268" font-size="9">OWNERS: 1 (TECH.)</text>
    </g>

    <!-- the price flap. it cannot make up its mind and neither can the network -->
    <g>
      <rect x="470" y="228" width="126" height="52" fill="#120d08" stroke="#6d5525" stroke-width="1"/>
      <line x1="470" y1="254" x2="596" y2="254" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <text class="ll-tag" x="482" y="246" font-size="9">TONIGHT'S TOP PURSE</text>
      <text class="ll-cur" x="584" y="273" font-size="20" text-anchor="end">₵ {purse_showcase}</text>
    </g>

    <text class="ll-tag" x="320" y="304" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">EVERY OTHER LOT PLAYS FOR ₵{purse_round} · PAID OUT TODAY: ₵{paid_today}</text>
    <text class="ll-tag" x="320" y="322" font-size="9" text-anchor="middle">SOLD AS SEEN · NO RETURNS · NO PROVENANCE PROVIDED OR IMPLIED</text>
    <text class="ll-tag" x="320" y="340" font-size="8" text-anchor="middle" opacity="0.7">KSAB-TV · COLDWATER BASIN · LIVE ON THE FLOOR</text>
  </g>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="640" height="360" fill="url(#ll-scan)"/>
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="640" height="360" fill="url(#ll-vig)"/>
</svg>
name: the_last_lot_logo
